about: Renders a list of tabs and the panel of the selected tab.

fitted.about: Tabs at their own width, and tabs sharing the list's width equally, in the enclosed look, where each tab's width shows.
fitted.title: Fitted

holds: The balance, the limits and the owners of the account.

justify.about: Every distribution of the tabs in a list wider than they are.
justify.title: Distribution

lately: The payments and changes of the last thirty days.

orientation.about: The list across the top, and down the start. The machine's `orientation` option sets it, and the indicator and the arrow keys follow.
orientation.title: Orientation

palette.about: Every palette in the line look. The palette colours the indicator and the selected tab's text.
palette.title: Palettes

size.about: Every size. The size sets the tab's height and text on the control scale, and the panel's padding.
size.title: Sizes

title: Tabs
tuned: The notifications, the currency and the statement day.
